text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First place goes to T.M. Opera O! She's
earned
the honor of becoming a Derby
champion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! Spandendo! More,
more!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is I who shall perform the victor's
aria!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But, yes... I know. The rest of our cast
will not be
leaving the stage anytime
soon.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that right, my history-making
comrades?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh! Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's nothing! Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I think that was a first?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You were staring right at her, and you
looked...
frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... Really, though, I'm disappointed
too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping I'd be the one to make you
look like
that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'm sure of it now. You'll be even
stronger
at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I won't be slacking off though! I'll keep
training
during summer camp. I'll focus
on stamina as much
as I can!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Then we'll compete again, Ayabe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This time, at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: We'll do this all again...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (My legs are shaky... I'm tired.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(But my body feels oddly light, like a
balloon
drifting away after the string was
cut...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Almost like... I could start running
again, at this
very moment.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The final race of the Classic Triple
Crown is next...
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm sure it'll be like today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
